race.description: Yirribee Pacing Stud Cattlewash Trotters Mbl
race.comment: ALDEBARAN DENBAY (4) brings terrific form from Victoria having made it three wins in a row when leading from a similar barrier before scoring by 2 metres at his latest appearance at Shepparton. First try here but can extend the winning streak. ISLAND FRANKIE (3) has been a beaten favourite in both starts since a spell, breaking fresh then leading and fading last time but he has trialled well since and should be close to peak fitness. Draws well so worth another chance. CASUALCONNECTION (9) draws wide but is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish only 1.5m away when second at this circuit and distance. Lightly raced and has scope for further progression. VULCAN STRIDE (2) will be fitter for recent racing and draws to advantage.
